recommended_next_phase.title: Expanded Dataset Model-Free Alpha Screen
recommended_next_phase.purpose: Run a new model-free screen of prioritized price/volume alpha candidates (residual momentum, short-horizon residual reversal, volatility-adjusted momentum) on the expanded survivorship-caveated dataset, explicitly excluding standalone avg_dollar_volume_21d as an alpha candidate. Still no model training, no model candidate, and no production integration.

stopped_candidate_policy.reason: The standalone liquidity candidate avg_dollar_volume_21d failed the Phase 2K-I expanded survivorship-caveated retest (residual rank IC reversed negative) and Phase 2K-J stopped it. Phase 2K-K does NOT re-screen it as a standalone alpha; it may appear only as a control / diagnostic / neutralizer if needed.

excluded_candidates.reason: avg_dollar_volume_21d failed the Phase 2K-I expanded retest and was stopped by Phase 2K-J as a standalone alpha. It is excluded from the screen as a ranking signal and is only ever computed as a size / liquidity control or diagnostic, never screened or ranked here.

residualization_config.method: per-date cross-sectional OLS (usable controls + intercept); residual = forward excess label - fitted (same construction as Phase 2K-B / 2K-C / 2L-B / 2K-I)
residualization_config.robust_fallback: cross-sectional demean when no control is usable, a control is constant, or the date has fewer than min_names usable names
residualization_config.no_lookahead: controls are trailing point-in-time features; the label is strictly forward; each per-date fit uses no forward information

research_priorities.action: Promote only the candidate / horizon pairs that earn KEEP_FOR_WALK_FORWARD_CONFIRMATION to a stricter embargoed walk-forward confirmation phase; do not train a model and do not create a model candidate yet.
Diagnose RESEARCH_LEAD_ONLY pairs (which robustness / stability gate failed and why) before deciding whether they justify more data or a point-in-time universe.
Attach a low-cost point-in-time sector map and screen sector-relative momentum / reversal model-free (deferred backlog item), still with no model training.
Scope a point-in-time membership universe to remove the survivorship caveat before any production claim; do not purchase or build on paid data yet.

recommendation.reason: No pair cleared every confirmation gate, but 15 pair(s) were directionally positive and survive only as research leads; they need diagnostics before any confirmation. No model candidate is created.

interpretation.narrative: Phase 2K-K screened the prioritized price/volume alpha candidates from the Phase 2K-J refreshed backlog on the expanded, survivorship-caveated D: panel, explicitly excluding standalone avg_dollar_volume_21d (stopped after the Phase 2K-I expanded retest failure). Only model-free, rank-only metrics on the beta/vol-neutralized residual forward-excess label were measured across the full sample and regime / year stability splits -- nothing was fitted. The screen produced only directionally-positive research leads, none robust enough for confirmation. Every result is reported as survivorship-biased / current-membership caveated. No model was trained, fitted, scored, or served, and no model candidate was created. Even a KEEP only permits a later, separately gated confirmation phase; it is not a production edge.

recommended_next_phase.purpose: Diagnose the research leads that were directionally positive but not robust enough for confirmation (which gate failed, and whether more data or a point-in-time universe would change the verdict). No model candidate is created.
